writers._doc: Quoted words in a readable object's text are spoken by whoever wrote them, never by the narrator the player chose. voice: a narrator or cast id; instead: who reads it when the player's narrator is that same voice; filter: ffmpeg audio filter applied to the writer's words.

grandmother._filter_doc: An old woman: a little headroom first (Piper writes to full scale), pitched down and slowed (asetrate 0.9), a 5 Hz tremor in pitch (vibrato, done in Python by build_voices.conform) and loudness (tremolo), and a thin band like an old recording.

_licence: Every voice here is public domain (LibriVox recordings or LJ Speech), so the game can be sold. Credit each one in js/remastered/credits.js; test/remastered-manifest.js checks it. Chosen 2026-11-07.
